title: Checkout requests returning errors
description: Customers report intermittent HTTP 500 responses when submitting baskets beginning around 10:00 UTC.

title: Payment requests waiting and failing
description: Payment requests take several seconds and some return 503. A release notification was posted shortly before the alert.

title: Users cannot refresh sessions
description: Browser clients report rejected session refreshes. Other API calls still appear healthy.

title: Product pages take longer to load
description: Product detail requests have risen from hundreds of milliseconds to several seconds; requests eventually succeed.

title: Intermittent gateway timeouts
description: Requests across several endpoints are timing out during a busy period. Failures fluctuate minute to minute.

title: Some users cannot load profiles
description: Support reports repeated profile failures for some users, while the main availability dashboard remains green.

title: Invoice downloads failing again
description: Invoice downloads return 502. Operators recall a similar alert from an earlier incident.

title: Search requests returning server errors
description: Some text searches return HTTP 500. The error rate increased shortly after 10:00 UTC.

title: Background jobs are delayed
description: Job completion has slowed and the queue is growing. Some operational dashboards are not responding.

title: Occasional export request failures
description: Two users reported failed exports around 10:00 UTC. The failures could not be reproduced immediately.
